notes: Modified cash basis village audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total column (pp7-10; fund columns General, Road, Lottery, Ambulance, Garbage, Fire Hall, Police, Library, Adjustments). The Garbage Fund is reported by the village as a governmental fund (Sanitation) and is kept governmental. transfers_in/transfers_out are the Total column's printed figures (transfers in 990, transfers out 0 after the Adjustments column eliminates 335,288; p10), as in FY2024; detail other-financing lines stay per fund (in 336,278, out 335,288). Fund balance 797,317 -> 688,626. ending_cash = governmental funds Cash and Cash Equivalents 681,803 (p6); Cash at County Treasurer 6,823 is a separate line; no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash is null. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement Totals (p12); the Statement of Activities (p2) business-type column carries the same figures (charges 864,310, disbursements 895,871 incl. depreciation); net position 1,567,013 -> 1,542,715. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1; includes capital assets); the governmental funds balance sheet (pp5-6) and proprietary statement of net position (p11) are also in the trim. Zero-valued cells skipped. Detail: revenue by fund from the governmental funds statement columns, expenditures by object and fund from the Schedule of Expenditures (pp16-17; Grants Fund all zero), utility funds from the proprietary statement columns. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Total Primary Government (pp14-15, combined all funds, budgetary cash basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-17 of 17
